[[Image:Greatwood Vale.jpg|thumb|Greatwood Vale]]

The '''Greatwood Vale''' is a forested valley in the foothills of the [[Stonetalon Mountains]]. Linking the dry expanse of the [[Barrens]] to the mountains proper, the fertile recesses of the vale have been a hunting and camping region for the [[Tauren]] tribes for millennia. Recently, the [[Grimtotem|Grimtotem Tribe]] has attacked and destroyed the Tauren loyal to the Horde in the region, burning [[Camp Aparaje]] to the ground and murdering most of the inhabitants. Horde agents have been sending adventurers into the vale to assault the Grimtotems there.
